verdict.rationale: Contract validation is a fair question for an API client like Hoppscotch, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only general test scripting (test cases, `hopp test` with JUnit reports) and OpenAPI import for organizing requests. Nothing documents validating live responses against an API contract or schema to detect drift. Hand-written test scripts and OpenAPI import are adjacent building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can validate live responses against the API contract to catch drift
